explicit_records.amended_clustering_is_governing: root_dedup.py is the single clustering implementation; Milestone D must BIND it, never reimplement or layer a second competing clustering.
explicit_records.mirror_not_used_in_dedup: NO mirror machinery exists anywhere in the executable solver: mirror coordinates are never computed, never deduplicate roots, never choose a representative, never change SolverStatus. Mirror pairs surface only generically as multiple roots. Milestone D adds mirror DIAGNOSTICS only.
explicit_records.v2_golden_root_sets: 6 identify fixtures (IDENTIFIED x2, MULTIPLE_ROOTS x2, NON_IDENTIFIABLE, NO_ROOT) + dedup_unit section (chain refusal, close cluster, multi-root, first-server provenance, boundary metadata)

governing_rules.ambiguity_refusal: diameter >= _DEDUP_TOL -> component refused; reason AMBIGUOUS_ROOT_TOLERANCE_CHAIN; public NON_IDENTIFIABLE dominates
governing_rules.boundary_rule: on_boundary = min(pa-lo, hi-pa, pb-lo, hi-pb) < _BOUNDARY_TOL (0.005), strict <, computed at root acceptance in _solve_one (inline expression, not yet a named seam)
governing_rules.exception_behaviour: CoherenceMathError on invalid domain/targets/line, non-finite dedup candidates, and math-layer refusals; iteration exhaustion raises nothing
governing_rules.first_server_representation: bool a_serves_first (True = A serves first); governed order for keys: A-first before B-first
governing_rules.first_server_union: identify: NON_IDENTIFIABLE in per-statuses dominates, then MULTIPLE_ROOTS; else union = canonical dedup of roots from solves with status in {IDENTIFIED, BOUNDARY_SOLUTION}; union ambiguity -> NON_IDENTIFIABLE; 0 -> NO_ROOT; 1 -> BOUNDARY/IDENTIFIED; >1 -> FIRST_SERVER_SENSITIVE_PENDING_THRESHOLD; degenerate branch unions ALL per-solve roots with the same ambiguity override
governing_rules.public_serialization: NONE built into the result dataclasses; golden serializes ad hoc; digest material exists only at the dedup layer (RootDeduplicationResult.digest, sort_keys canonical json)
governing_rules.root_count_rules: per-solve: ambiguous->NON_IDENTIFIABLE; 0->NO_ROOT; >1->MULTIPLE_ROOTS; 1-> NON_IDENTIFIABLE if |jac|<_JAC_TOL else BOUNDARY_SOLUTION if on_boundary else IDENTIFIED

types.IdentificationResult: frozen dataclass (status: str, roots: tuple[Root], per_server: (ServerSolve, ServerSolve), domain: (float, float), line: Decimal, fmt: MatchFormat) — the public result; no serialize/digest methods (golden serializes ad hoc)
types.Root: frozen dataclass (p_a: float, p_b: float, a_serves_first: bool, residual: float = sqrt(r2) norm, jacobian_det: float, on_boundary: bool) — the current RootCandidate; no validate/serialize/digest methods of its own; fingerprint provided by root_dedup.candidate_fingerprint (sha256 over float.hex fields)
types.RootCluster: frozen (representative: Root, members: tuple[Root] fingerprint-ordered, diameter: float, provenance_digest: str) + serialize()
types.RootDeduplicationResult: frozen (clusters canonically ordered, ambiguous_components, reason: DedupReason|None) + ambiguous/representatives()/serialize()/digest()
types.ServerSolve: frozen dataclass (a_serves_first: bool, status: str, roots: tuple[Root])
